_comment: Committed snapshot of the PUBLIC runtime surface of tibber-aws. The consumer
smoke test asserts the installed package exports exactly these names, so an
accidental removal or rename shows up as a reviewable diff here instead of
silently breaking consuming services. Adding an export is a one-line change;
removing one is a breaking change and must be a deliberate major-version
'kind' is asserted too, because a class silently becoming a plain object (or
vice versa) still passes a name-only check.
